results.summary: Sky TPU 3x3 is an int4 band-engine TPU built around a 3x3 systolic array of pipelined 4-bit MACs with dual weight planes and an 8-deep accumulator bank. It includes a requantize plus ReLU readout path and an autonomous SPI-RAM DMA engine, and can chain layers on-chip for multi-layer neural network inference. Commands and data are driven over an 8-bit beat bus on ui[7:0], with results emitted as count-deterministic output frames on uo and uio[7:4]. The design is verified in simulation with cocotb against a Python golden model, and no silicon test results are reported.

results.summary: This project streams in a 20-byte IPv4 header one byte per clock cycle and decides whether to allow or drop the packet. It checks the header for errors, verifies the checksum, and identifies the protocol as TCP, UDP, or ICMP. After the final byte it outputs its decision based on whether the header is valid, has a valid checksum, and does not match the configurable blocked protocol, which defaults to ICMP. A full testbench is provided in test/test.py, and no silicon test results are reported.
